How much does a roof inspection cost in St. Louis?

Most St. Louis roof inspections range from $150 to $400, depending on your home's size, roof complexity, and access requirements. A typical 2,000 square foot home with standard roof pitch averages $200-$275. We offer free inspections for homeowners considering roof repair or replacement services . Pre-purchase and insurance inspections include detailed written reports with photo documentation.
How long does a roof inspection take in St. Louis?

Most residential roof inspections take 45 minutes to 2 hours with our experienced team. Simple ranch homes with accessible roofs can often be completed in under an hour, while complex two-story homes with multiple roof planes typically take 1-2 hours. Inspections requiring interior attic access add 15-30 minutes. Weather conditions can affect the timeline.
How often should I have my roof inspected in St. Louis?

St. Louis homeowners should schedule professional roof inspections every 2-3 years for roofs under 10 years old, and annually for roofs over 15 years old. You should also schedule inspections after major storms, before buying or selling property, when filing insurance claims, and whenever you notice warning signs like missing shingles, granules in gutters, or interior water stains.
What do roof inspectors actually look for?

Professional inspectors examine shingle condition including cracks, curling, and granule loss. We check flashing around chimneys, vents, and skylights. We evaluate gutter attachment and drainage patterns. We assess ventilation adequacy, fascia and soffit condition, and structural integrity. Interior inspections reveal attic ventilation, insulation problems, moisture damage, and signs of previous leaks.
Can you inspect my roof for insurance claims?

Yes, we provide detailed insurance inspection documentation for St. Louis homeowners filing claims after storm damage , hail events, or wind damage. Our reports include timestamped photographs, damage measurements, material identification, and professional assessment of repair or replacement needs. We can also meet with insurance adjusters to ensure all damage is properly documented and covered.
